title: CandidateLiteratureRecord
description: Standard schema for candidate literature records retrieved by the literature-discovery-acquisition skill.

id.description: Unique record identifier in current search session (e.g., REC001)

year.description: Publication year, or null if unknown

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier or 'NR' if unverified

url.description: Direct canonical landing URL or DOI resolution URL

abstract.description: Abstract text, or null / 'Not available' if unavailable

keywords.description: Author keywords or indexed MeSH terms

institution.description: Degree granting university or research institute if document_type is Thesis

degree_level.description: Degree level (Master vs PhD) if document_type is Thesis

source_databases.description: All databases where this record was retrieved (e.g., ['PubMed', 'OpenAlex'])

query_ids.description: All query IDs that hit this record (e.g., ['Q01', 'Q02'])

evidence_level.description: Strict verification level of this bibliographic record

screening_status.description: Screening status based on title and abstract

citation_count.description: Reported citation count if verified from database API

is_seed_paper.description: Whether this paper is chosen as a seed for citation chasing

citation_chasing_origin.description: If discovered via citation chasing, specifies chasing mode
